description:
Sell NO shares in a Stacks Market prediction market.

Uses the sell-no-auto function with a minimum proceeds guard.
The transaction will fail if proceeds fall below min_proceeds_ustx.

Requires an unlocked wallet. Only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

min_proceeds_ustx.description: Minimum acceptable proceeds in micro-STX (slippage protection)

shares.description: Number of NO shares to sell (integer, smallest unit)

name: stacks_market_sell_no
